title: INSTEAD OF Trigger
description: Learn how to use INSTEAD OF triggers to override INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE operations on views.

data.text: An INSTEAD OF trigger allows you to skip an INSERT, DELETE, or UPDATE statement to a table or view and execute other statements defined in the trigger instead.

data.title: CREATE INSTEAD OF TRIGGER syntax
data.content: Creates an INSTEAD OF trigger on a view for INSERT events.

data.text: A typical use case is to route inserts through a view to an approval table instead of directly inserting into the target table:

data.title: INSTEAD OF INSERT trigger on a view
data.content: Creates an INSTEAD OF trigger that routes inserts to an approval table.
data.code:
CREATE TRIGGER production.trg_vw_brands
ON production.vw_brands
INSTEAD OF INSERT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    INSERT INTO production.brand_approvals (brand_name)
    SELECT i.brand_name
    FROM inserted i
    WHERE i.brand_name NOT IN (
        SELECT brand_name FROM production.brands
    );
END

data.title: INSTEAD OF Trigger Key Points
points: INSTEAD OF triggers skip the actual DML operation and execute custom logic instead.
They are commonly used with views to enable insert/update/delete operations.
The trigger body has access to the INSERTED and DELETED virtual tables.
Use INSTEAD OF triggers for complex view modifications or approval workflows.
